warning.titlePre: Land Rover Discovery TDV6 Oil Leaks & Coolant System Wear
paragraphs: The TDV6 is a sophisticated 3.0-litre inline-six with an integrated starter-generator and electric auxiliary compressor — a more modern and efficient design than the older TDV6 V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every TDV6 rebuild.
Because the Discovery TDV6 uses a completely different engine family from the V8 M178 fitted to the Discovery 63 and GT 63 S, parts and rebuild specifications don't cross over between them.
warning.source: Source: Established TDV6 specialist pattern — timing chain, bearing and gasket wear across integrated-starter-generator inline-six units.
